LanguageData.CerebrexFlavourPack_Alert_CoreDamagedDes: A cerebrex core has taken heavy damage. If it is destroyed, every mech in your swarm shuts down permanently.\n\nUse the core's refurbish command to restore its integrity.
LanguageData.CerebrexFlavourPack_CoreLost_LetterText: The cerebrex core is gone.\n\nAcross the map the swarm stops mid-stride. {0} mechs have gone dark and will not answer again.
LanguageData.CerebrexFlavourPack_CoreLost_DialogText:
Your cerebrex core has been destroyed.

Without it, there is no command lattice left to hold the swarm together. What's left is cooling metal scattered across the ground where your mechs were standing.

This run is over.
LanguageData.CerebrexFlavourPack_ScenPart_CoreSummary: Start with a cerebrex core on the home map. If it is ever destroyed, the entire mechanoid swarm shuts down and the game ends.
